external_poll.status: public context only; not included in the district forecast

generic_ballot.margin_definition: D/R two-party margin: 100 × (D share − R share) / (D share + R share).
generic_ballot.timing_rule: Fieldwork ends by Oct. 30; verified later first-public dates are excluded, while unknown first-public timing remains unknown and is retained. The Polling Forecast API is as of Oct. 29; its 30-day generic-poll records match the Oct. 28 snapshot. Emerson and ActiVote primary pollster releases were verified through Oct. 30.
generic_ballot.source_coverage_note: The latest API run does not supply first-public dates for most records; fieldwork dates are not used as a publication-date substitute.

House.method: 435 district win probabilities are combined with an independent-race Poisson-binomial PMF. District margins and probabilities use the selected race-level forecast; their Democratic hard-favorite count is aligned to the selected House seat model's 209 hard calls. Expected seats are the sum of the district probabilities and can differ from that hard-call count. Single-party candidate display adjustments do not change this PMF.

Senate.coverage_note: 35 forecast races plus 65 fixed seats (34 Democratic-caucus, 31 Republican).

Governor.coverage_note: Covers 36 Governor races; source coverage is documented in the private release audit.

senate_seat_distribution.interpretation: Approximate range across the 35 listed Senate races and 65 seats already held; not a party-control probability.

summary.seat_range_note: Seat ranges summarize the published race forecasts and are best read alongside their expected totals.

governor_seat_distribution.interpretation: Range of Democratic wins among the 36 Governor races; not a party-control probability.

generic_ballot_forecast.target: National Democratic-minus-Republican House two-party popular-vote margin in percentage points
